🎨 STEP 9: CUSTOMIZE YOUR HOUSE

🌏 STEP 10: EXPLORE THE COMMUNITY

🏆 ST VIRTUAL WORLD – GAME RULES & BUILDING SYSTEM

📜 RULE 1 – ONE HOUSE PER PLAYER ID
Prathi Firebase Anonymous User ID ki oka player house limit apply avuthundi. Same browser/device lo automatic anonymous identity use avuthundi.

House save chese mundhu selected district, village/town/city and map position correct ga unnayo verify cheskondi.

Current GitHub version lo Instagram-style username enter cheyyali. Username syntax validate avuthundi and ST VIRTUAL WORLD lo already reserve ayindha ani check chesthundi. Idi Instagram account availability verification kaadhu.

⚠️ RULE 7 – SECOND HOUSE REQUEST

🛕 RULE 8 – COMMUNITY LANDMARKS
Temples, monuments, stadiums, malls and other special landmark models admin-managed placements. Regular players direct ga landmark records create cheyyaleru.

🏆 SCORING SYSTEM:

Instead, game main progress house creation, location selection and 3D customization meedha based untundi.
